educationalGoal: Gain basic knowledge of materials science for safe and comfortable buildings. Students gain understanding of the characteristics of building materials. Main materials to be studied: timber, steel products, cement concrete, finishing materials, functional materials
advice: This is a basic course in architectural materials science. We will cover the following: 1. Summary of architectural materials 2. Cement-concreate 3. Steel products 4. Timber 5.
